_header.status: INTERPRETIVE — converging evidence only, adjudicates nothing; the length checks (parts 1–3) are the decisive tests
_header.operative_conditional: parts 1–3 LANDED BADLY (deep length confound; transfer contaminated; matched check gated out) — this annex CANNOT rehabilitate the direction
_header.label_caveat: SAE feature names are auto-generated interpretations, suggestive never dispositive
_header.sae_caveat: base-model SAE (Llama-Scope L8R-8x) on instruct-model activations is an approximation; instruct-trained SAE exists only at L19 (Goodfire), 11 layers off-band
_header.encode_note: encode = jumprelu(a_scaled @ W_enc + b_enc), a_scaled = a * (6.3125 / mean ||a|| over our L8 anchors) — matches the SAE's dataset-average input norm; approximation stated
_header.attribution_note: attribution = cosine(direction, decoder row); reconstruction quality = R^2 of the direction onto its top-20 decoder atoms (the full 32k basis is overcomplete and reconstructs anything trivially)
